groups.caveat: Each group used its own HAP, so pairs inside a group subtract directly while across groups only the direction carries.

earlierThreeArm.purpose: Earliest comparison of the day; its cold 31 C CPU arm is the only measurement not limited by the charging floor.

namingConvention: "CPU arm" and "NPU arm" refer only to where the diarization speaker encoder runs. ASR runs on the CPU in every arm of every group (ORT, four threads, QoS default); no run in this report puts ASR on the accelerator. Whether it could is answered separately in section 8, and the answer is no. So a delta such as "diarization NPU minus recognition only" means the arm with diarization enabled and its encoder on the accelerator, minus the arm with diarization switched off.
